scripts.check: npm run runtime:stage && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.dev: npm run runtime:stage && npm run proxy:install && tauri dev
scripts.build: npm run runtime:stage && npm run proxy:install && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:unsigned: npm run runtime:stage && npm run proxy:install && node scripts/build.mjs --unsigned
scripts.build:debug: npm run runtime:stage && npm run proxy:install && tauri build --debug
